Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — proposed term changes

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week. We’re preparing to renew our contract that expires Feb 15, 2027 and want to add capacity for the new analytics tier. High level: 3x current token throughput, a 24-month term (preferred), and stricter audit logging retention for 7 years (audit requirement).

Legal has a few requests and will need a redline:
- Confirm auto-renewal notice window (we prefer 90 days vs your standard 60).
- Add a capacity addendum to reflect burst capacity pricing and reserved pools.
- Include a clause for SOC2 evidence access for customer-led audits (on-site or remote).

Can you share a redlined MSA and updated order form we can review? Evan will coordinate procurement. We’ve penciled in a target effective date of Feb 16, 2027.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks,
Kate Morgan
Head of Procurement
Stratos Analytics

- Capacity addendum: we’ll produce an addendum that lists reserved baseline + burst pricing. I’ve asked finance for a scoped table; Priyom, can you confirm the expected committed tokens/month for the baseline?
- SOC2/customer-led audit clause: legal prefers scheduled remote evidence access; for on-site we may need an SOW for logistics and costs.

Attached: MSA_redline_2026-11-10.docx (initial legal redline), OrderForm_Stratos_v3.xlsx (pricing + capacity workbook). These are draft redlines — Laura, please add any negotiation notes inline. Kate/Evan — please confirm committed baseline and burst profile so we can populate the order form.

> Attached: MSA_redline_2026-11-10.docx (initial legal redline), OrderForm_Stratos_v3.xlsx (pricing + capacity workbook).

Kate / Evan — quick legal notes inline:
- Section 2.1 (Term & Renewal): updated to 24-month term + 90-day opt-out language. Please confirm you are ok with the notice method being written notice via email to both parties.
- Section 7.4 (Audit / Evidence Access): added a scheduled remote evidence access process; for on-site audits we added an SOW trigger (customer reimbursement of incremental costs).
- Section 11 (Service Levels & Credits): clarified latency SLOs for the added reserved capacity and tied credits to baseline, not bursts.
- Data retention/audit logs: we propose a 7-year retention option as an add-on line item rather than default; this avoids impacting other customers unless purchased.

Commercial question for Sean / Priyom: Stratos asked for 3x throughput. If they commit to a 2x baseline + 1x burst (pay-as-burst), we can hold list pricing and offer a 12% uplift discount for the 24-month commit. If they want 3x guaranteed baseline, we need to move to a higher reserved price band (approx +28%).

I’ve attached a PDF of consolidated comments (Stratos_Renewal_Counter_2026-11-18.pdf) that includes a legal summary + suggested concessions. Kate — if you can confirm baseline committed tokens/month, we’ll feed final numbers into OrderForm_Stratos_v3.xlsx and produce a final redline.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Stratos_Renewal_Counter_2026-11-18.pdf (PDF summary, legal comments)
